title: Neon Rush
tagline: The city never sleeps. Neither do you.
description: Neon Rush is a fast, synth-heavy arcade runner set above a flooded megacity. Chain wall-runs, steal momentum from rival couriers, and stay ahead of the midnight shutdown.
longDescription: Built for short sessions and high-score chasers, Neon Rush puts you in the boots of a courier threading rooftops under a permanent electric storm. Every run is a new route through the city: hit the clean line, bank your combo, and leave a brighter trail than the last runner.
